name: Foster Electric Company, Limited
summary: Foster Electric Company, Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells loudspeakers, audio equipment, and electronical equipment in Japan, China, the United States, rest of Asia, Europe, and internationally. It operates in three segments: Speaker, Mobile Audio, and Other. The company offers various speaker products, including automotive, USB, general, flat-screen TVs, and 2 in 1 vibration, as well as speaker systems. It also provides mobile audio products, such as mobile phone headsets, headphones, earphones, Bluetooth headsets, and earphone drivers, as well as vibration actuators.
